mentions.name: PostalAgent
mentions.description: This platform automates direct mail, letting users trigger physical postcards from the same workflows they already use for email via an API, Zapier, and native integrations with Jobber and Zoho. An upcoming Shopify integration enables abandoned cart and win-back mail campaigns for stores whose customers have opted out of email. It requires no bulk minimums and no design software.
mentions.problem: Email averages ~20% open rates on a good day, making it unreliable, while a physical postcard stays on someone's kitchen counter for two weeks.
mentions.audience: for people who've given up on email open rates; stores whose customers have opted out of email

mentions.name: PostalAgent
mentions.description: This web service sends personalized postcards online: users upload a CSV or circle neighborhoods on Google Maps to build an address list of consumers or businesses, with printing and postage included in one price. It recently added Zapier and Jobber integrations, following earlier Pipedrive, Zoho, and Follow Up Boss integrations.
